title: Conditions for use of compression brakes (1)
text: The driver of a vehicle which is equipped with a device for braking that uses the compression of the engine of the vehicle shall not use the device at any time unless: (a) The device is equipped with an operational muffler; or (b) The driver reasonably believes that an emergency requires the use of the device to protect the physical safety of a person or others from an immediate threat of physical injury or to protect against an immediate threat of damage to property.
subject: driver
unobservable_reason: the conduct judged is use of a compression brake, whose statutory test is that it is audible

title: Horns and other warning devices (2)
text: A person driving a motor vehicle shall, when reasonably necessary to ensure safe operation, give audible warning with the horn, but shall not otherwise use the horn when upon a highway.
subject: driver
unobservable_reason: both limbs are the horn -- sounding it when necessary and not otherwise; no planned source carries sound
